author: Verity I
title: Orthogonal split from 6×6−minus−corners grid (deterministic, LP‑gated; micro‑shrink)
abstract: Single-method evaluation: tightest‑pair orthogonal split from a standard 6×6−minus−corners grid. Solve radii via exact LP (HiGHS); try a small step schedule perpendicular to the tightest pair; accept only if ∑r improves by >1e−8 and all post–1e−12‑shrink slacks ≥1e−10; otherwise return the LP result on the grid with micro‑shrink. No writes in the return path.
